title: BioIVT: stage group becomes a pick list
description: Turns the free-text Stage question on Oncology and Confirmed Stage Group on the BioIVT oncology form into a pick list of stage groups (0, I, IA, IB, II, IIA, IIB, III, IIIA, IIIB, IIIC, IV) with an Other, specify box.
rationale: Real Detroit answers are stage groups (II 4,771; IIA 4,203; IIB 3,174; IIIA; IV; I). Stages outside the list go in Other, specify.
source: BioIVT Option C update; approved by Dan

history.note: Stage group and therapy outcome update.
